jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished portrait 9:16 background for a mobile three-lane mecha auto-shooter game. Painted high-quality stylized 3D diorama, chunky industrial toy geometry, subtle cel-shaded material edges, polished game concept art. CAMERA: fixed elevated rear-third-person camera looking straight forward, symmetrical one-point perspective, vanishing point at horizontal center and 27% height. A wide CLEAR THREE-LANE road occupies central 74% of the image from 38% height to bottom, its two fine cyan inset lane seams reach x38.5% and x61.5% at 60% height. Ground is quiet matte and readable, props only at far sides. Upper 22% clear low contrast for HUD. No characters, no enemies, no guns, no gates, no painted UI, no text or logos, no watermarks. Road and structures have believable depth, lighting and perspective. Crisp but restrained details in playable area. Environment: DAWN FACTORY EXIT. Warm peach sunrise beyond a bright ivory and blue toy robot assembly complex. Orange overhead gantry cranes and teal battery containers on side platforms, industrial ventilation towers, small cyan floor lights. Optimistic clean ivory / slate teal / warm orange palette. Road is desaturated blue steel, not black. A large round factory hangar distant at horizon. The whole scene should feel distinct, readable and premium.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production TRANSPARENT game sprite atlas, landscape 2:1 image, EXACT 4 equal columns x2 equal rows, 8 square cells, no drawn grid/text/UI/watermarks. One substantial 3D sci-fi walk-through ARCH GATE per cell, camera elevated third person looking through the arch away into distance, matching polished ivory/navy toy mecha game. This is a real open doorway with TWO THICK BEVELED SIDE PILLARS, visible inside side faces, deep metal upper lintel, floor base rails and a wide oval ground contact light/shadow. Keep CENTER OPEN AND TRANSPARENT so a player mech visibly fits through it. Main feet/threshold registration at x50%, y85% in every cell; all four frames exactly same camera/size/position. Gate occupies middle80% width and y18..88% height, includes transparent margin. Row1 REWARD GATE ivory armor, emerald/cyan edge lights, glowing cyan floor strips. Row2 TRAP GATE graphite metal, copper orange/red edge lights, red floor strips. Columns 1 distant idle dim energy; 2 ready-to-enter glowing inner rim and ground threshold clearly lighting up; 3 crossing feedback with short energy streaks through doorway and outward expanding ground light, frame itself remains; 4 after crossing fading energy, unchanged gate registration. Keep visible metal thickness and side depth, three-dimensional rendered painted game art with convincing shading, not flat UI cards or neon rectangles. Upper lintel has a SMALL BLANK dark metal plaque for runtime icon. No background, genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG BOSS SPRITE ATLAS for a mobile toy-mecha shooter. Portrait4:5 canvas, EXACT 4 equal columns x5 equal rows (20 square cells). No grid, text, labels, watermark or background; genuine transparency. Each cell one FULL BODY boss viewed from front slightly above, facing toward bottom of image/player, fixed at center with generous margins, feet anchored y88%, fixed body registration and scale across row. Richly painted stylized 3D industrial toy mecha, polished metallic shading, bold readable silhouette, restrained glowing details. Five ORIGINAL very different bosses: row1 orange/ivory squat four-legged FACTORY FOREMAN tank, broad dual industrial cannon arms, small cyan furnace eye; row2 white/cobalt DRONE QUEEN with sleek swept aircraft wings and rotor halo, two missile pods, floating; row3 burgundy/graphite IRON BASTION with massive hexagonal armored torso and huge asymmetric shield arm plus short mortar; row4 violet/navy STORM ORACLE hovering crystalline reactor with three orbiting mechanical fins and purple lightning core, narrow spectral silhouette; row5 ivory/navy/gold STAR EMPEROR with tall royal knight armor, six-point core, floating segmented golden halo and elegant star-blade shoulder panels. FOUR columns are consecutive actions: idle machinery closed, charging with pods/vents opening, FIRING down toward viewer with brief short muzzle flash and mechanical recoil, recovery vents/exhaust. Boss stays in place; no translation or camera shift; each row's weapons actually change/open. All parts/effects contained within cell with safety margins. Original designs, no recognizable existing franchise characters. Not flat icons, not silhouettes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG ANIMATED PLAYER SPRITE ATLAS. Reference image is STYLE AND BASE CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only. Generate ONE square image, EXACT4 equal columns x4 equal rows, 16 square cells. Full-body small toy mecha running AWAY from viewer toward TOP of image, rear third-person elevated view. KEEP same head/back/hips registration, same camera, same body height across all16 cells; feet y90%, head y12%. Four columns form natural run loop: left leg forward/right back, passing pose, right leg forward/left back, opposite passing pose. Arms natural single-arm shooter stance; RIGHT FOREARM kept raised forward toward top for a separate cannon overlay; no giant embedded guns or muzzle flashes. Four rows are visually distinct WHOLE BODY upgrades matching projectile family: row1 cyan pulse armor, clean ivory/navy original identity with cyan back reactor and twin short shoulder prongs; row2 cobalt rail armor, sharper blue plated shoulders/thighs, aerodynamic white side fins and blue strip rails; row3 violet plasma armor, dark navy and lavender body plates, purple crystal back reactor, three subtle crescent floating modules close to back; row4 gold star armor, ivory navy gold plates over entire body, six-point back reactor, golden segmented small halo and star-shaped shoulder fins. Maintain same recognizable original toy robot proportions, full-body readable silhouette and polished painted3D game art, not a simple palette swap. Each sprite stays completely in its own cell with generous transparent padding, no texts/grid/background/watermark, genuine transparent alpha. Strong contour readability at32px display size.
